sub_graphs.title: EIP-8: RLPx Handshake Protocol
sub_graphs.description: Models the forward-compatible RLPx TCP transport handshake with variable-length packets

nodes.label: Handshake Initiated
nodes.description: Initiating client A has begun the RLPx handshake process

nodes.label: Generate Auth Packet
nodes.description: Create EIP-8 auth packet with signature, initiator-pubk, initiator-nonce, auth-vsn=4, and 100-300 bytes padding

nodes.label: Auth Packet Sent
nodes.description: Auth packet (auth-size || encrypted-auth-body) transmitted to peer

nodes.label: Decrypt Auth Packet
nodes.description: Receiving client decrypts ECIES ciphertext using recipient static private key

nodes.label: Parse Auth Body (Tolerant)
nodes.description: RLP decode auth-body, ignoring version mismatches, additional list elements, and trailing data

nodes.label: Auth Packet Validated
nodes.description: Auth packet successfully decrypted and parsed with required fields extracted

nodes.label: Generate Ack Packet
nodes.description: Create EIP-8 ack packet with recipient-ephemeral-pubk, recipient-nonce, ack-vsn=4

nodes.label: Ack Packet Sent
nodes.description: Ack packet (ack-size || encrypted-ack-body) transmitted to initiator

nodes.label: Handshake Complete
nodes.description: Both parties have exchanged auth/ack and can derive session keys

edges.label: Peer A initiates connection to Peer B

sub_graphs.title: EIP-8: Packet Validation Rules
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation rules that are removed or relaxed for forward compatibility

nodes.label: Packet Pending Validation
nodes.description: Incoming packet requires validation before processing

nodes.label: Check Required Fields
nodes.description: Verify presence of required fields: signature, nonces, public keys

nodes.label: Skip Version Check
nodes.description: Per EIP-8, version number validation is intentionally skipped

nodes.description: Additional RLP list elements and trailing data are ignored

nodes.description: Packet passed all required validation checks

nodes.label: Validation Failed
nodes.description: Packet failed validation - missing required fields or ECIES decryption failure

ambiguities.text: The recommended padding range of '100-300 bytes random' does not specify the distribution or entropy requirements for the random data.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume cryptographically secure random bytes are required to prevent traffic analysis attacks.

ambiguities.text: The phrase 'silently discarded' for unknown packet types does not specify if this should be logged or counted for rate limiting.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume silent discard means no error response to sender, but local logging may occur for debugging.

ambiguities.text: No specification for handling simultaneous connection attempts between two peers using different protocol formats (v4 vs EIP-8).
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the receiving node determines format based on packet structure and responds in the same format.

implicit_assumptions.description: The ECIES encryption with recipient's static public key ensures only the intended recipient can decrypt auth/ack packets.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Man-in-the-middle attacks could intercept and forge handshake packets.

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot generate valid signatures without the initiator's private key.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Connection hijacking or impersonation attacks possible.

implicit_assumptions.description: All future protocol versions will maintain backward compatibility with the RLP structure requirements.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Forward compatibility breaks, negating the purpose of EIP-8.

implicit_assumptions.description: The 1280 byte discovery packet limit is sufficient for all current and future discovery message types.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Protocol extensions may be blocked by size constraints.
